title: A client with no SubtitleProfiles has a mode-picked text subtitle burnt in, so its film re-encodes
notes: Accepted by D-068 because the alternative ignores the viewer's saved mode. Promote to a brief with the design-arounds if dogfood decision lines show SubtitleCodecNotSupported with subtitle_asked=none and method=reencode or refused from a supported client other than jellyfin-web under burn-all. Drop if JS-075's clients all send SubtitleProfiles. Closed at the pivot: Both auditors: tied to Jellyfin's API, its apps, jellyfin-web or its captures, which go at the cutover (D-107, mandate rule 3).
